change-beta-20251213-beta-20251225.lineage: Result of the analysis tool soil-moisture-change of Lynkeus 0.1.0 on the layers: Soil moisture, 13 Dec 2025, Retrieval quality flag, 13 Dec 2025, Soil moisture, 25 Dec 2025, Retrieval quality flag, 25 Dec 2025. Method: Difference of the layer soilMoisture of two dates, later minus earlier, in the cells whose retrieval the layer retrievalQualityFlag does not mark as not recommended on either date (bit 0 is 0) (image differencing: Singh, 1989, https://doi.org/10.1080/01431168908903939; NASA SDS Product Specification, L3 SME2, JPL D-107677 Rev C). NISAR marks the retrieval of every cell with a soil moisture on both dates as recommended, so none is left out. Reduced copies made by averaging the values.
